title: ShareUpdateRequest
description: share.update-request@1: network-wide sharing. Ids only; no resource title or content. Members apply to people audience; pending recipients may preview for seven days. `lock` sets how the resource itself is sealed (Locker).

lock.description: How the resource is sealed (Locker). Set when the item is registered; a save may echo the same value but cannot change it.

envelope.description: A locker.envelope@1, base64: the content re-sealed for the people who stay, sent with the members that remain when someone is removed from a people-locked item. The service stores it (never opens it) before it drops the member.
